result.interpretation: Descriptive predictions versus the named completed recorded behavior; no fabricated cutoff labels, causal attribution, or independent-action confidence intervals. Recorded behavior may differ from the checkpoint value-training policy, so errors do not isolate value accuracy under a counterfactual continuation. Actor agreement measures fit to recorded search targets, not independently optimal actions. Training-split fit is in-sample; this diagnostic cannot select a student or alter frozen confirmation.

initializer_lineage.meaning: The direct-view initializer preserves chunk-15 weights, which precede the actual chunk-20 250000 endpoint; no old artifact is repinned.

limitations: Authored, calibrated Ironclad A0 inventories, not a natural campaign population.
All cases begin from explicit public setup declarations; campaign/corpus/native bridge anchors are not supplied.
Held-out inventory variants only upgrade one Strike; they are not broad unseen-deck evaluation.
Development confidence intervals are exploratory after teacher/student selection; confirmation is independently frozen.
Combat rewards ignore future potion value and use cleanup HP; they do not establish Act 1 improvement.
Search remains opt-in; no default, serving checkpoint, or bridge release promotion.

execution.finish: Stop admitting work before deadline; retain every planned row and separate cutoffs/failures/defeats.

learning.reanalysis: Only after passing round one: refresh a predeclared 96-fight prefix (8 balanced family rounds) from training round one with the newer teacher, preserving old outcome provenance; combine with 480 fresh round-two fights.
learning.second_round_gate: Best student passes the same positive paired-return lower-bound / nondecreasing-win gate against the original network on development, and student+search does not regress wins against the selected original searched controller.
learning.targets: Legal search distributions and completed behavior returns; truncations never become defeats; all wins and losses retained.
learning.teacher: Frozen selected teacher per round, retaining its tested simulation/leaf configuration; no hidden-state inputs.

protocol.lineage_correction: Checkpoint weights match chunk-15: 199152 specialist PPO decisions, not the 250000 endpoint; all old artifacts/hashes remain unchanged.

pilot.selection: Choose final rollout simulation budget from measured latency only before development; compare at similar thinking cost.

reserved_variants.meaning: One previously unupgraded Strike upgraded in each profile; a limited inventory perturbation, not broad unseen-deck coverage.

restrictions: No PPO updates from search behavior

student_development.pairing: Match benchmark identity, split, case_index and full public opening across reports; UUIDs are not cross-report pair identities.
student_development.selection: Challenge wins with search, mean challenge return with search, greedy challenge wins, then lower learner seed. Report all learner seeds, and greedy comparisons separately.

teacher_development.freeze: Same initializer for all controllers; no tuning on outcomes of the three previously diagnosed cases.
teacher_development.gate: All planned fights complete without failures/cutoffs, at least 95% eligible search coverage and no incomplete search budgets; positive paired challenge return with its percentile source-fight bootstrap 95% lower bound > 0, and no lower challenge win count than network.
teacher_development.selection: Among passing teachers: challenge wins, challenge mean return, lower measured eligible latency, stable name. Root teacher is allowed; no automatic default promotion.
